verdicts.reason: A is close to a straight recentre of the original and keeps the hierarchy and centred axis intact. It still has problems: the side margins are wide and empty, the legal line is tiny and runs into the missing-asset placeholder, and a bokeh dot sits on the body copy. B moves things around badly: the SOLSTICE logo floats on its own to the left of the can, and the SUNSET SALE tag drifts into the top centre. The badges and CTA are crammed into a 2x2 grid, so the CTA reads like just another badge beside SMALL BATCH. The bottom of B is cramped while the top is empty, and the legal text also hits the placeholder.
